class V5P3TrancheAPreliminaryDataset(Dataset):
    """Preliminary Tranche-A Dynamic70 windows.

    Returned x shape: [16,70,32]. The underlying run tensor stores log1p
    Dynamic70. Provisional A-only train normalization is applied at read time.
    Physical topology is returned separately as [16,10].
    """

    def __init__(self, root, split, active_only=False):
        self.root = Path(root).resolve()
        self.split = str(split)
        self.active_only = bool(active_only)
        manifest = json.loads((self.root / "tensor_manifest.json").read_text())
        self.window = int(manifest["window"])
        self.records = [item for item in manifest["runs"] if item["split"] == self.split]
        if not self.records:
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"No processed runs for split {self.split!r}")
        self.topology = torch.load(self.root / "topology.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)
        self.normalization = torch.load(
            self.root / "normalization_tranche_a_provisional.pt",
            map_location="cpu",
            weights_only=False,
        )
        self.mean = self.normalization["mean"].to(torch.float32)
        self.std = self.normalization["std"].to(torch.float32)
        self.index = []
        for file_index, record in enumerate(self.records):
            flags = record["target_attack_flags"]
            for start in record["valid_window_starts"]:
                target = int(start) + self.window - 1
                if self.active_only and not bool(flags[str(target)]):
                    continue
                self.index.append((file_index, int(start), target))

    @staticmethod
    @lru_cache(maxsize=8)
    def _load(path):
        return torch.load(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.index)

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        file_index, start, target = self.index[index]
        record = self.records[file_index]
        run = self._load(str(self.root / record["relative_path"]))
        stop = start + self.window
        x = (run["x_log1p"][start:stop] - self.mean) / self.std
        x = x.permute(1, 2, 0).contiguous()
        return {
            "x": x,
            "physical_port_mask": run["physical_port_mask"],
            "edge_index": self.topology["edge_index"],
            "y_attack": run["y_attack"][target],
            "y_attacker_count": run["y_attacker_count"][target],
            "y_source": run["y_source"][target],
            "y_transit": run["y_transit"][target],
            "y_victim": run["y_victim"][target],
            "y_attack_path": run["y_attack_path"][target],
            "role_mask": run["role_mask"][target],
            "source_target_router": run["source_target_router"][target],
            "epoch_id": run["epoch_id"][target],
            "epoch_tick": run["epoch_tick"][target],
            "pair_id": run["pair_id"],
            "case_id": run["case_id"],
            "run_id": run["run_id"],
            "pair_member": run["pair_member"],
            "family": run["family"],
            "strength_profile": run["strength_profile"],
            "window_start": start,
            "window_target": target,
            "normalization_scope": "provisional_tranche_a_train_only",
        }
